system/io.vectory.agent = {
	active count = 0
	path = /Library/LaunchDaemons/io.vectory.agent.plist
	type = LaunchDaemon
	state = spawn scheduled

	program = /usr/local/bin/vectory
	arguments = {
		/usr/local/bin/vectory
		run
		--state-dir
		/Library/Application Support/Vectory/agent
	}

	stdout path = /dev/null
	stderr path = /dev/null
	default environment = {
		PATH => /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
	}

	environment = {
		XPC_SERVICE_NAME => io.vectory.agent
	}

	domain = system
	username = _vectory

	umask = 77
	minimum runtime = 10
	exit timeout = 330
	runs = 2
	forks = 2
	execs = 1
	initialized = 1
	trampolined = 1
	started suspended = 0
	proxy started suspended = 0
	last exit code = 2

	spawn type = daemon (3)
	jetsam priority = 40
	jetsam memory limit (active) = (unlimited)
	jetsam memory limit (inactive) = (unlimited)
	jetsamproperties category = daemon
	jetsam thread limit = 32
	cpumon = default
	probabilistic guard malloc policy = {
		activation rate = 1/1000
		sample rate = 1/0
	}

	properties = keepalive | runatload | inferred program | system service | tle system
}
